note: Python safety layer. The C++ bridge has its own compiled-in allow-list; both must agree before anything changes. Anything not listed here is blocked. Settings marked "switch": "allow_exposure" may only change when that switch is on in BOTH layers (bridge started with --allow-exposure, runner/gate with exposure=True); otherwise only ISO changes.

IsoSensitivity.note: Approved 2026-10-17. The default: the only setting that changes without the exposure switch.

WhiteBalance.approved_range: AWB or ColorTemp mode only (Color Temp is needed to set Kelvin; AWB is how the camera was found)
